info.name: EIC Shareholder Bridge API v19.0.2.0.8
info.description: EIC Shareholder Bridge v19.0.2.0.8 API collection. The login tests store sender_session_id and receiver_session_id separately. Authenticated requests send an explicit Cookie header, allowing sender and receiver workflows to be tested in one collection run. Logout is skipped unless run_logout=true. Odoo API scalars are intentionally serialized as strings. Use transfer_decision=accept for the full completion path or reject for the rejection path. Cancel Transfer is skipped by default because it is mutually exclusive with completion.

variable.description: Saved from sender login; used explicitly in Cookie headers.

Set true only when intentionally testing logout; false keeps collection-run sessions alive.
Use accept for the happy path or reject for the receiver-rejection scenario.
Set true only when manually testing cancellation before receiver verification.
